components.role: 60mm commercial mortice lock body, excluding its standard cylinder

components.role: SSS lever-on-rose furniture, both sides

components.role: SSS outside cylinder escutcheon

components.role: SSS inside turn-snib

components.role: 6-pin restricted-keyway cylinder, master keyed and stamped, with two change keys
components.caveat: Schlage SR3 6-pin oval-cylinder proxy. The published cylinder price includes master keying, stamping and two cut change keys. Confirm cam fit and key registration with the lock supplier; the visible escutcheon is priced separately.

components.role: EN 1154 size 3-capable closer with adjustable EN 2–4 power, fixed arm and matched SSS finish
components.caveat: Published silver Briton 1120B rate is a proxy; +24–61% prices the manufacturer's 1120B.S SSS-cover variant with matching arm. Briton confirms EN 1154 and adjustable EN 2–4 power, but the NZ price for the SSS variant needs a supplier quote. Includes the arm and supplied fixings; no separate cover or arm is added.

components.role: closer pull-side adaptor/backplate
components.caveat: Separate Briton 1120 adaptor plate because the specified scope requires a soffit/backplate. Confirm its fixing detail on the steel-reinforced timber jamb. Fixings supplied with the plate are not priced again.

components.role: three 100 × 75 × 3.0mm SSS ball-bearing butt hinges
components.caveat: Unreviewed QV supply-only rate is $39.20 each for a 100 × 75mm stainless fixed-pin butt hinge. Three give $117.60; up to +40% allows for the specified 3.0mm gauge and ball bearings. Confirm the exact hinge with Allegion, NZ Hardware or Unique Hardware.

components.role: one SSS floor door stop
components.caveat: Unreviewed QV $51 floor-mounted stainless Miles Nelson stop. Whether fixing is included is unclear; no separate stop-fitting time is added.

components.role: on-site fitting, closer adjustment, lubrication and testing
components.caveat: 1.5–2.5 hours per already-hung, pre-morticed leaf at the published Auckland installation labour rate. Covers lock, cylinder, furniture, three hinge changes, closer and adaptor plate, plus sweep/latch adjustment and testing. Excludes site setup and separately priced key cutting; no extra stop-fitting time is added.

components.role: third registered change key and shared master keys
components.caveat: The cylinder already includes two change keys. One additional restricted key is priced using the published SR1 cut-key rate as a proxy for SR3, plus two master keys amortised over 25 leaves. Confirm SR3 key-cutting price and registered-key procedure.

components.role: single-visit site setup, hardware schedule check-off and handover
components.caveat: Professional allowance of $250–$500 across 25 leaves for one-floor setup, schedule check-off, and handing over keys and warranties. Master keying and cylinder stamping are already in the cylinder price.

band.basis: Component sum is $1,040.43–$1,318.03 per leaf, rounded outward. Midpoint is about $1,180 per leaf; 25 leaves are about $26,000–$33,000 excl. GST. components.role: Three 100 × 75 mm stainless butt hinges

components.role: Framing: three door-opening jambs, trimmers and lintels
components.caveat: Unreviewed $13.70/m stud row proxies the additional steel around three 980 × 2100 mm openings: roughly two to four extra jamb lengths plus lintel/trimmer lengths per opening, divided by 120 m2. Doors, frames and hardware are excluded.

components.role: Linings: 13 mm standard plasterboard supplied and fixed, both faces
components.caveat: This is a cost-plan allocation from the unreviewed $55/m2-per-face QV row, which includes fixing AND Level 4 stopping. Board area is 113.826 m2 per face after deducting three 980 × 2100 mm openings. The linings and stopping components together represent this one composite row, widened for uncertainty; they are not two purchases.

components.role: Linings and insulation: R1.8 glasswool acoustic cavity infill

components.role: Stopping: Level 4 to both faces, including corners and corner bead
components.caveat: Cost-plan allocation of the same unreviewed $55/m2-per-face board-fixing-and-Level-4-stopping row used for linings. QV's stopping-only row has no Auckland price. Corners and beads are treated as included in this allocation because their inclusion in the composite wording is unclear; no separate corner rate is added.

components.role: Acoustic sealant at head, base and abutments, both faces
components.caveat: Unreviewed QV 10 × 5 mm acoustic-sealant bead is $3.40/m. Range covers approximately 198–230 m of bead: head and base across about 44 m on both faces, plus an assumed four to ten vertical abutments. The lining row does not expressly include sealant.

components.role: Site allowance: set-out, trestles or mobile scaffold, and offcuts to skip
components.caveat: Professional allowance of $720–$1,440 across 120 m2 for the level-3 lift movements, short-duration access equipment and offcut removal to an available skip. Routine fixing labour and material cutting already inherent in installed QV rates are not added again.

band.unit: NZD/m² gross wall elevation, GST exclusive
band.basis: Working cost-plan band for the fixed scope, not a certified price. Component lows and highs add to $179–$229/m². At 120m² gross wall elevation, the total is $21,480–$27,480 excluding GST. Framing is $59–$79/m²; linings and insulation $75–$89/m²; allocated stopping $34–$44/m²; sealant and minor direct site costs $11–$17/m². The plasterboard rate is applied to net board area but amortised over 120m². Confidence is low because the QV rows are unreviewed, the stopping split is an allocation, the R1.8 product must fit a 64mm cavity, and the soffit height and deflection-head detail need confirmation.

components.role: Framing: 64mm studs and ordinary tracks
components.caveat: QV Auckland rate is $41/m² for a 0.55mm, 64mm non-load-bearing frame at 600mm centres. Applied to the gross 120m² elevation. The row is unreviewed; ordinary track and fixings are treated as included. Powder-actuated bottom-track pinning is assumed within this rate and is not charged again.

components.role: Framing: deflection head to soffit
components.caveat: Unreviewed 64mm Rondo J-track row is $29.90/m, used only as a proxy for the specified deflection head. Allow 30–70% above that proxy for the slip detail, then credit the $13.50/m ordinary top track already in the framing rate (QV row 1c18ef10bea6cf9c3af1924a465705de7e5c366a537200bab64843383970be7d:t0:r7). Applied over about 44m; upper end also covers short stud extensions above the grid. Soffit height is unknown.

components.role: Framing: one row of 64mm noggings
components.caveat: QV Auckland add-extra rate is $8.20/m² per row. One row assumed. The base framing row does not state that noggings are included; both rows are unreviewed.

components.role: Framing: three door openings, jambs, trimmers and lintels
components.caveat: Net extra for three 980 × 2100mm openings, after credit for regular framing displaced by the voids. QV proxy is $16.90/m for 64mm 0.70BMT stud, with $16.80/m top-track proxy for lintels (row 1c18ef10bea6cf9c3af1924a465705de7e5c366a537200bab64843383970be7d:t0:r11). Both rows are unreviewed. No doors, frames or hardware.

components.role: Linings: 13mm standard plasterboard supplied and fixed, both faces
components.caveat: This is a QS allocation from the unreviewed $55/m²-per-face QV rate, which includes both fixing and Level 4 stopping. The companion stopping component allocates the rest of that same rate; they are not two added published rates. Board area is 113.826m² per face after deducting three 0.98 × 2.10m voids.

components.role: Linings: R1.8 glasswool cavity infill

The upper rate allows for a compatible R1.8 product; confirm product and installed R-value with an NZ insulation supplier.

components.role: Stopping: Level 4 both faces, including corners and bead

components.role: Acoustic sealant: head, base and abutments, both faces

components.role: Direct site allowance: set-out, trestles or mobile scaffold, offcut removal to skip
